envelope.description: Add the kind codecs, the creation context and the shared decoder

body.title: Add the kind codecs, the creation context and the shared decoder
body.summary: Add the codec registry with a codec per existing kind except AMD, each owning encode(payload, ctx) and the kind's identity meta; define the codec creation context type and its provider so a create with no prior head obtains workflow, runId, repoPath, createdAt, epicCreatedAt, elapsedMs, repoIndexedAt and schemaVersion; add the pure synchronous decodeArtifactHead; make the AMD codec refuse a flat amendment with a pointer to the s9 conversion.
acceptanceChecks: decodeArtifactHead fills every envelope part for a head with envelope parts and returns empty parts for a head without them
a create without a prior head builds a head whose workItemAnchorCreatedAt and Define renderer results are the ones an existing writer would produce
a flat amendment, a malformed head and an unknown kind are refused with the documented errors

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/decode.test.ts: decodeArtifactHead fills every envelope part, returns empty parts for a head without them, and refuses a malformed head, an unknown kind and a flat amendment
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/codec-create.test.ts: a create without a prior head builds identity meta that workItemAnchorCreatedAt and the Define renderer accept
